# tcpsystems/hetzner-mcp — Complete LLM Reference

> Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (`cmd/mcp-hetzner`) providing structured Hetzner Cloud resource management (servers, firewalls, networks, volumes, SSH keys, floating IPs, actions) while isolating API credentials from agent contexts.

## Architecture & Security Boundaries

1. **Startup Token Resolution (`internal/auth`)**:
   - Loads `HCLOUD_TOKEN` from environment or `~/.config/hcloud/cli.toml` (`HCLOUD_CONTEXT`).
   - Attaches authentication headers inside the MCP server process; connected agents never receive tokens or raw headers.
2. **Listener Guard (`cmd/mcp-hetzner/guard.go`)**:
   - Default transport is `stdio`.
   - When `--transport http` is used on any non-loopback address (`--host`), startup fails closed unless `MCP_AUTH_TOKEN` is configured.
3. **Tool Catalog & Server (`internal/catalog`, `internal/server`)**:
   - Registers typed MCP tools over `mark3labs/mcp-go` and `hetznercloud/hcloud-go/v2`.

## Verification
- Build: `go build -o mcp-hetzner ./cmd/mcp-hetzner`
- Gate: `go vet ./...`, `go test -race ./...`, `staticcheck ./...`, `govulncheck ./...`
